module_role: M-506 written-controls context: bounded source statements, network qualification, and sensor/zone limitations. It complements the exact M-506 I/O matrices; it does not create an installed-equipment or sensor count from typical diagrams.

parser_disclosures.description: The visual source uses degree glyphs in the occupied/unoccupied temperature statements. MuPDF and Poppler both expose the wording, but Poppler places the standalone 0/F glyph text in a different native word order. The human-readable source statement is retained exactly as displayed; independent assertions deliberately stop before the affected degree-glyph runs rather than fabricating parser agreement.

network_architecture.protocol_context: The general notes say onboard BACNET controllers shall communicate with the BAS and be monitored and controlled from the GUI, with unimpeded two-way communication with all devices.

statements.text: OCCUPIED MODE: THE BUILDING SHALL BE "OCCUPIED" FROM 8 A.M. (ADJ.) TO 6 P.M. (ADJ.), MONDAY THRU FRIDAY. TEMPERATURE SETPOINTS: COOLING: 78 0F (ADJ.), HEATING 68 0F (ADJ.).

UNOCCUPIED MODE: THE BUILDING SHALL BE "UNOCCUPIED" FROM 6 P.M. (ADJ.) TO 8 A.M. (ADJ.) MONDAY THRU FRIDAY AND ENTIRE DAY ON SATURDAY AND SUNDAY. TEMPERATURE SETPOINTS: COOLING 80 0F (ADJ.) AND HEATING: 55 0F(ADJ).
ZONE SETPOINT ADJUST: THE OCCUPANT SHALL BE ABLE TO ADJUST THE ZONE TEMPERATURE HEATING AND COOLING SETPOINTS AT THE ZONE SENSOR BY ±2°F.
TEMPERATURE CONTROL DEVICES SHALL BE EQUIPPED WITH DEADBANDS THAT COMPLY WITH IECC 2015.

zone_mapping.note: M-506 supplies operating requirements but no plan/room-zone map or installed zone-device count.

sequences.title: MINI-SPLIT CONTROL SEQUENCE
sequences.equipment_scope: MINI-SPLIT SYSTEM; P&ID marked as template/two generic typical AHU/CU callouts, not an installed count

statements.text: THE MINI-SPLIT SYSTEM SHALL REMAIN ENABLED DURING ALL HOURS.
MINI-SPLIT CONTROL: THE MINI-SPLIT SYSTEM SHALL BE PROVIDED WITH A FACTORY FURNISHED ON-BOARD BACNET CONTROLLER. THE MANUFACTURER SHALL USE ITS PREFERRED SEQUENCE TO MEET THE FOLLOWING REQUIREMENTS:
THE SPACE AIR TEMPERATURE SETPOINT SHALL BE MONITORED
SYSTEM SHALL BE ENERGIZED TO MAINTAIN THE SETPOINTS 78°F (ADJ.).
THE ONBOARD BACNET CONTROLLER SHALL COMMUNICATE WITH THE DDC TO ALLOW THE MONITORING AND CONTROL OF I/O POINTS LISTED HERE. THE SYSTEM SHALL BE ENABLED 24/7.
ALARMS: THE ONBOARD BACNET CONTROLLER SHALL TRANSMIT SYSTEM ALARMS TO THE GUI. THE ONBOARD CONTROLLER SHALL, AT A MINIMUM, TRACK ALARMS LISTED IN THE I/O POINTS LIST.

sequences.title: EXHAUST FAN CONTROL SEQUENCE
sequences.equipment_scope: SWITCH CONTROLLED EXHAUST FAN P&ID; source does not enumerate a quantity of exhaust fans

statements.text: THE SYSTEM SHALL BE CONTROLLED BY THE BAS AND SHALL OPERATE AS FOLLOWS:

EXHAUST FANS SHALL BE ENABLED WHEN THE LIGHT SWITCH IN THE WOMEN/MEN'S RESTROOM, SHOWER/LOCKER ROOM, OR JANITOR ROOM IS ON. EXHAUST FANS SHALL ENERGIZE WHEN OCCUPANCY SENSOR IN THESE ROOMS IS TRIGGERED.
EXHAUST FANS SHALL DE-ENERGIZE WHEN NO OCCUPANCY IS DETECTED BY THE OCCUPANCY SENSORS FOR 15 MINUTES (ADJ.).
ALARMS: THE ONBOARD BACNET CONTROLLER SHALL TRANSMIT SYSTEM ALARMS TO THE GRAPHIC USER INTERFACE (GUI). THE ONBOARD CONTROLLER SHALL, AT A MINIMUM, TRACK ALARMS LISTED IN THE I/O POINTS LIST.
